# Primary GMN test extracts

Data credit: Global Meteor Network, CC BY 4.0.
License and scientific citation guidance: https://globalmeteornetwork.org/data/
License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/

`gmn-2018-extract.txt` retains the original header and two bright rows from
https://globalmeteornetwork.org/data/traj_summary_data/traj_summary_yearly_2018.txt
Downloaded 2026-10-01. IDs: 20181231103455_6R0hP, 20181231114855_x32yo.

`gmn-2025-extract.txt` retains the original header and the row 20251227031631_xiL2Z from
https://globalmeteornetwork.org/data/traj_summary_data/daily/traj_summary_20251226_solrange_275.0-276.0.txt
Downloaded 2026-10-01. The observation occurs on December 27 despite the filename.

These are selected test rows, not complete coverage or an event catalogue. Raw rows
are unchanged; selection is the only modification. Summary generation timestamps
are retained. Numeric fields, their meaning, uncertainties, and interpolation
limits are described in docs/RecordedFireballs.md.
